display_name: Nymeria - Xsens MVN Link 17-tracker suit (8 placements)
placement: eight of the suit's seventeen trackers, simultaneous: head, sternum (T8), pelvis, left forearm, right forearm, right upper arm, right thigh, right shank
note: Device-frame accelerometer reconstructed from MVNX sensorFreeAcceleration (gravity-removed, global frame) rotated by sensorOrientation with +9.80665 m/s^2 re-added along the world up axis, then divided by 9.80665 -> g with gravity PRESENT. Gyroscope is segment angularVelocity (global) rotated into the same sensor frame; rad/s. Falls back to segment acceleration + orientation when sensor-level fields are absent (recorded in manifest.json as acceleration_source). Unlabeled: reserved marker __unlabeled__, Phase-A only. Grids are float16.
